html:
The Musgamagw Dzawada'enuxw are a group of Kwakwaka'wakw First Nations of the central coast of British Columbia, whose lands include Kingcome Inlet and the islands of the Broughton Archipelago.

They fished salmon and eulachon, gathered clams and cedar, and held feasts and the potlatch, which Canada banned from 1884 to 1951. Their neighbours include the Wuikinuxv to the north. In recent decades they led a long campaign against open net salmon farms in the archipelago, which they blamed for harming wild salmon, and won the removal of many of them.
